In January 2025 the coastal town of Pantai Mutiara Timur introduced a deposit scheme paying Rp 200 for every returned bottle. Within twelve months it recovered 4.6 million bottles, and volunteer beach cleanups collected 71 percent less plastic than the year before.

In my opinion, the scheme worked because it turned waste into small but reliable income for scavengers and schoolchildren. A regional regulation now requires that "all beverage sellers display the deposit value on the label."

Critics say programs like this are costly. The town's budget shows the scheme cost Rp 1.3 billion, less than it previously spent on waste hauling. Not every region will get the same results. Incentives, not slogans, drive lasting change in behavior.

# LedgerLite

A double-entry bookkeeping library for small businesses. Every transaction must balance to zero before it can be saved, which stops the silent drift in balances that many early adopters lived with in their spreadsheets.

Built by the Open Finance Collective in Yogyakarta. First stable release: version 1.0.0, 30 June 2026.

## Requirements

Python 3.11 and above. No external dependencies apart from SQLite.

## Install

```
pip install ledgerlite
```

Then run the example in `examples/quickstart.py`.

## Storing amounts

"all amounts must be stored as integers in the smallest currency unit" to avoid floating-point errors.

## Performance

On a standard laptop, LedgerLite posts 50,000 journal entries in under 9 seconds.

## Contributing

27 contributors have worked on the codebase so far. See CONTRIBUTING.md.

## License

Apache 2.0

# FieldNotes

An offline-first mobile app for researchers who collect survey data in remote areas. Forms are stored locally in an encrypted database and sync automatically when a connection returns.

FieldNotes was built for the Coral Reef Monitoring Network of Wakatobi Selatan, whose teams surveyed 64 dive sites during the 2025 field season. Survey boats spend up to 9 hours a day without mobile signal. Before FieldNotes, paper forms were retyped at the station, and an internal review found a 6 percent transcription error rate.

## Requirements

Current release: v2.4. Runs on Android 10 or later. Photo attachments up to 12 MB each.

## Build from source

You need Flutter 3.22 and a Firebase project configured for the sync service.

## Contributing

"every schema change must include a migration script and a rollback."

## License

GPL-3.0

# Queuebird

A job queue for Node.js. Every job is written to Redis before acknowledgment, so a crash never loses queued work.

Two engineers at the agency Studio Kelapa started Queuebird in 2025 after their email jobs kept vanishing during server restarts. In production at Studio Kelapa it processes about 1.8 million jobs per day with a median latency of 42 milliseconds.

## Requirements

Node.js 18 or newer, Redis 7.0 or newer.

## Install

```
npm install queuebird
```

Set the connection with the `QUEUEBIRD_REDIS_URL` environment variable.

## Retries

Failed jobs are retried up to 5 times with exponential backoff, starting at 2 seconds.

## Contributing

One firm rule: "never merge a change that lowers test coverage below 90 percent."

As of September 2026 the project has 3,400 stars on GitHub.
